CREATE TEMP TABLE hkm33_unwrap ON COMMIT DROP AS
SELECT a.id, a."lawName", a."articleNumber" n, a."articleBis" bis, a.content previous_text,
  btrim(substring(a.content from '["«]\s*(.*?)\s*["»]')) new_text,
  btrim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(a.content, '["«]\s*.*?\s*["»]', '[النص]'), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) note_text,
  coalesce(substring(a.content from '(المرسوم الملكي رقم\s*\([^)]*\)\s*وتاريخ\s*[0-9/]+هـ)'), substring(a.content from '(قرار مجلس الوزراء رقم\s*\([^)]*\)\s*وتاريخ\s*[0-9/]+هـ)'), substring(a.content from '(الأمر الملكي رقم\s*\([^)]*\)\s*وتاريخ\s*[0-9/]+هـ)')) instrument,
  substring(a.content from 'وتاريخ\s*([0-9]{4}/[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{1,2})هـ') hijri
FROM legal_articles a WHERE a."lawName"='نظام العمل' AND ((a."articleNumber" IN (233,234,235) AND a."articleBis"=0) OR (a."articleNumber"=229 AND a."articleBis"=1))

g1_unwrap_labor.name: guard_before
g1_unwrap_labor.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM hkm33_unwrap)=4 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM hkm33_unwrap WHERE new_text IS NULL OR length(new_text)<30 OR instrument IS NULL OR hijri IS NULL)=0 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM hkm33_unwrap u WHERE position(u.new_text in u.previous_text)=0)=0 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_text_provenance WHERE source_id='hkm033-unwrap-2026-10-23')=0 THEN 'ok' ELSE (1/(SELECT count(*) FROM legal_systems WHERE false))::text END guard

CREATE TEMP TABLE hkm33_unwrap2 ON COMMIT DROP AS
SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.id, a."lawName", a."articleNumber" n, a."articleBis" bis, a.content previous_text,
  btrim(substring(a.content from '["«]\s*(.*?)\s*["»]')) new_text,
  btrim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(a.content, '["«]\s*.*?\s*["»]', '[النص]'), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) note_text,
  coalesce(substring(a.content from '(المرسوم الملكي رقم\s*\([^)]*\)\s*(?:و|ب)تاريخ\s*[0-9/]+هـ)'), substring(a.content from '(قرار مجلس الوزراء رقم\s*\([^)]*\)\s*(?:و|ب)تاريخ\s*[0-9/]+هـ)'), substring(a.content from '(الأمر الملكي رقم\s*\([^)]*\)\s*(?:و|ب)تاريخ\s*[0-9/]+هـ)')) instrument,
  substring(a.content from '(?:و|ب)تاريخ\s*([0-9]{4}/[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{1,2})هـ') hijri,
  (a.content ~ '["«][^"«»]+["»]\s*\.?\s*$') quoted_to_end, (length(a.content) - length(replace(a.content,'"',''))) quote_marks
 FROM legal_articles a WHERE a."articleBis"<100 AND a.content ~ '^\s*-?\s*(أُ?ضيفت هذه المادة|أضيفت هذه المادة|إضافة مادة تحمل الرقم|تم تعديل هذه المادة|عُدلت هذه المادة|استُبدلت)' AND a."lawName"<>'نظام العمل') c
WHERE new_text IS NOT NULL AND length(new_text)>=30 AND instrument IS NOT NULL AND hijri IS NOT NULL AND quoted_to_end AND quote_marks=2

CREATE TEMP TABLE hkm33_unwrap3 ON COMMIT DROP AS
WITH s AS (SELECT a.id, a."lawName", a."articleNumber" n, a."articleBis" bis, a.content previous_text,
  CASE a.id
    WHEN 'cmpzcvbtt0bppvtrkw8v3zn9s' THEN substring(a.content from 'والتي تنص على الآتي:\s*(.*)$')
    WHEN 'cmpz5yf59028jcwg2ag9pmzpo' THEN substring(a.content from 'وذلك بالنص الآتي:\s*(.*?)\s*"\.?\s*\(\s*الجدول الملحق[^)]*\)\s*$')
    WHEN 'cmpz9ehyy0cdrybvv6n5dvz6y' THEN substring(a.content from 'لتكون بالنص الآتي:\s*"\s*(.*)$')
    WHEN 'cmpz9eli50cf1ybvvkpwn7ryx' THEN substring(a.content from 'لتكون بالنص الآتي:\s*"\s*(.*)$')
    WHEN 'cmpzcuyse082fvtrk91oxhkly' THEN substring(a.content from 'تنص على الآتي:\s*(.*?)\s*"\s*\.?\s*$')
  END raw_text,
  coalesce(substring(a.content from '(المرسوم الملكي رقم\s*\([^)]*\)\s*(?:و|ب)تاريخ\s*[0-9/]+هـ)')) instrument,
  substring(a.content from '(?:و|ب)تاريخ\s*([0-9]{4}/[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{1,2})هـ') hijri
 FROM legal_articles a WHERE a.id IN ('cmpzcvbtt0bppvtrkw8v3zn9s','cmpz5yf59028jcwg2ag9pmzpo','cmpz9ehyy0cdrybvv6n5dvz6y','cmpz9eli50cf1ybvvkpwn7ryx','cmpzcuyse082fvtrk91oxhkly'))
SELECT id, "lawName", n, bis, previous_text, btrim(raw_text, E' \n\t"') new_text, btrim(replace(previous_text, btrim(raw_text, E' \n\t"'), '[النص]')) note_text, instrument, hijri FROM s
